55/G.goal: Explain how a three-dimensional graphics pipeline processes objects into pixels and classify the major three-dimensional object-representation categories, including their trade-offs.
55/G.achieves: Equips the learner with foundational graphics concepts needed to understand rendering workload and make informed VR resource-optimization decisions.

55/O1.goal: Explain how the three-dimensional graphics pipeline stages and coordinate transformations convert objects into framebuffer pixel values.
55/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a basis for identifying where rendering computation occurs in VR systems, supporting later analysis of VR resource optimization.

55/O2.goal: Classify the major categories of three-dimensional object representation, including point-sample, boundary/mesh, parametric/spline, and space-partitioning methods, and explain their trade-offs and specialized uses.
55/O2.achieves: Enables the learner to assess how object-representation choices affect realism, storage, and rendering work, which is needed for VR system design and resource optimization.
